root_cause: Agent V2 relied on narrow phrase-specific intent patterns and could answer Brain-internal diagnostic questions through direct_assistant when no exact phrase matched.
fix: Added generic evidence-required policy in intent_classifier for Brain/repo/memory/dashboard/LangGraph/trace/financial/capability domains.
Added planner counterpart evidence_required_diagnosis with generic read-only evidence tools.
Prevented generic phrases like 'usar herramientas' from being treated as explicit tool names.
Kept casual chat on direct_assistant and kept unsafe real-money trading blocked.
